einzeiler: Pet detective Jim Tierney on tracking lost animals in New York City.
kurzfassung: Jim Tierney discusses his work tracking lost pets in New York City. He explains how dogs' behavior changes when they get lost and become more like wild animals. He also shares his tracking methods and experiences working with distressed owners.
stichpunkte: Tracking lost pets around New York City
Methods used to find missing animals
beschreibung:
Jim Tierney, pet tracker, has worked on more than 250 lost pet cases around New York City. Jim says once a dog is lost, their behavior changes. “They become less like your pet, and more like a wild animal.” In this episode Jim talks with Zoe Azulay about his tracking method, what it’s like to work with distressed pet owners, and why he didn’t become an animal lover until after his divorce.
